description: This file contains Pydantic schema definitions for configuration and feature toggle data validation and serialization within a student management system backend API.

classes.name: ConfigBase
classes.description: Base schema for configuration items with common fields and validation.

classes.name: ConfigCreate
classes.description: Schema used for creating new configuration entries.

classes.name: ConfigUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating existing configuration entries.

classes.name: ConfigResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning configuration data with metadata.

classes.name: FeatureToggleBase
classes.description: Base schema for feature toggles with validation.

classes.name: FeatureToggleCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating new feature toggles.

classes.name: FeatureToggleUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating existing feature toggles.

classes.name: FeatureToggleResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning feature toggle data with metadata.

classes.name: RuntimeConfigResponse
classes.description: Schema representing runtime configuration data including feature toggles and metadata.

classes.name: ConfigBulkUpdate
classes.description: Schema for bulk updating configurations and feature toggles.

classes.name: ConfigExportResponse
classes.description: Schema for exporting configuration and feature toggle data.

classes.name: ConfigImportRequest
classes.description: Schema for importing configurations and feature toggles.

methods.name: validate_key(cls, v)
methods.description: Validator ensuring the `key` field contains only allowed characters.

methods.name: validate_name(cls, v)
methods.description: Validator ensuring the `name` field for feature toggles contains only allowed characters.

methods.name: validate_environment(cls, v)
methods.description: Validator ensuring the `environment` field is within the allowed environment list.
